reviews.title: was OK, now broken
reviews.text:
I appreciated competing search results to that of Google and very much appreciated the early integration of LLM models from OpenAI.  I used Bing notifications to keep track of headlines not in my normal RSS feeds.  However, the app is now irritatingly useless on my current iPad:

1. Badge indicating 80 unread notifications, yet the notifications list is empty.  Nothing I do can change it from being empty.  And the notifications list count increases.

2. MSN embedded articles and videos prioritizing ads _to the exclusion of the actual content_ (!!!) such as that the value of seeking the content is horribly diminished.  It is _far_ better when you see an article you find interesting to note the source and _use Google to find the article at the source's own website_!!!  And if that's the case, why bother?

3. Videos are _literally_ unwatchable on my iPad.  As in, "I can't make any video play for love or money."  The video can play without sound, or the video can link to an ad, or the video can sit at a freeze frame.  The one thing a video can't do?  Play.  Hitting _any_ control on a video to make it play or unmute ... launches an ad.

Why put up with irritation?  And I _am_ irritated, enough to leave a review.  Now deleting the app.

reviews.title: How do Microsoft allow this sub par performing app into the world?
reviews.text:
- The news feed hardly changes. I've had the same news stories in the scrolling banner for over a week.
- The search results are mostly inaccurate and are nowhere near as accurate as Google (but even Google has declined to a sorry state).
- Forced ads galore.
- On iPad the static ads below the banner scrolling (same news stories) spilling over the sides of the screen. You can't even side swipe to bring them into view. Such poor design. 
- The tasks to acquire +10 reward points like 'Search deals to earn +10' has never once triggered a reward - none of the additional tasks have.
- With the 'Search and earn +3 reward points' if you tap on an offered title for rewards but is something you have search before you do not get the +3 points. In which case DON'T ADVERTISE IT AS A SEARCH OPTION THAT GIVES YOU +3 POINTS. UPDATE YOURSELF.

Using the Bing app is a frustrating experience from start to finish. If Microsoft do not have a Quality Control Manger then they need to create that position and employ someone competent.

It's bloody awful!
